bio.text: Tony Exum, a Democrat, has represented Colorado Senate District 11 in El Paso County since January 9, 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, Exum previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives (2013 to 2015 and 2017 to 2023) and worked as a firefighter for the Colorado Springs Fire Department.

According to Ballotpedia, Exum was born in and lives in Colorado Springs, graduated from William J. Palmer High School in 1970, and earned a B.S. in social science from the University of Southern Colorado in 1994.
